items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: The interviewee Wallace Davenport is not present in the transcript; the mention of Bill Bailey is made by the Interviewer, who states 'I was in the studio' and describes a recording session involving Clifford Brown, Placite, and Frog. There is no evidence in the text that Wallace Davenport personall

ctx.x: Go out through the swinging doors, turn right and follow your nose. We could stop unless you... Unless you want to get the music. Might as well, it won't hurt to have it. We can continue talking.

Actually, what he said was, he slipped a little Clifford Brown in there. Yeah. One of the interesting things back on that, at least I took one, on that Bill Bailey, was I was in the studio when they were dubbing. And after both Placite and Frog had finished, they played it back for him. And with the addition of the trombone and bass, I mean that tune really, really was really swinging. And Placite just came out spontaneously. He says, If that doesn't bring Bill Bailey home, nothing will. Yeah. Let me tell Kitty.
